application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description: Works to a tree covered by LBE ORDER NO 1 : (T1) Cedar - reduce crown by 3 metres, remove detached and dead branches from crown, remove partially failed hanging branch ends. No living attached first order branches to be removed from the crown.
decision_conditions: This consent is valid for two years.Reason: In order that the nature of work pertaining to this consent remains appropriate.

The works hereby approved shall be strictly limited to a 3m crown reduction, and removal of any hanging debris in the crown. The first order branch at approx. 8m height, southern aspect, with the hazard beam crack shall not be removed but shall undergo the same 3m reduction as the other branches, thus lessening the load on the defective part. The works shall only be carried out strictly in accordance with British Standard 3998 [2010] 'Tree Works'.Reason: In the interests of the health, safety and appearance of the preserved tree.

Tree work should not be carried out during periods that are likely to interfere with or disturb breeding birds or mammals.Reason: In order to comply with the requirements of the Wildlife and Countryside Act (1981) and Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations (2010).
